purpose: Compare js-reverse-ops against strong adjacent reverse-engineering skills and toolchains using repeatable capability categories, not a vendor leaderboard.

profiles.label: js-reverse-ops
profiles.notes: Evidence-driven JS reverse workflow with public benchmarks, release safety, replay gates, and delivery artifacts.

profiles.label: Broad browser MCP server
profiles.notes: Strong when direct CDP, debugger, network, hook, source-map, and automation tools are available in one MCP surface.

profiles.label: Static decompiler stack
profiles.notes: Strong for source maps, bundle splitting, obfuscator cleanup, AST transforms, and semantic renaming.

profiles.label: Agentic JS reverse skill
profiles.notes: Strong for task decomposition, browser-first procedure, hook guidance, and report-style delivery.

profiles.label: Cross-domain RE MCP
profiles.notes: Strong for binary, packet, mobile, WASM, and debugger handoffs across specialized analysis lanes.

dimensions.label: Browser runtime surface
dimensions.market_pressure: Strong tools expose browser automation, CDP debugging, network interception, JS hooks, storage/cookie observation, worker and WASM hints.
quality_gates: Prefer minimal hooks before widening capture.
Preserve observed browser facts separately from planned hook actions.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Keep multi-adapter browser MCP smoke records covered by public release checks.

dimensions.label: Static deobfuscation
dimensions.market_pressure: Static stacks recover source maps first, split bundles, clean obfuscator patterns, run AST transforms, and support semantic renaming.
quality_gates: Recover original source from source maps before spending effort on AST cleanup.
Treat static output as inferred until runtime or replay evidence confirms it.
Keep source minimization before semantic naming or cloud tools.

dimensions.label: Anti-detection profile discipline
dimensions.market_pressure: Modern browser reverse workflows often need named stealth, fingerprint parity, storage-state, or preload profiles without confusing bypass success with signer correctness.
quality_gates: Record the selected profile in artifacts.
Require replay or server acceptance before claiming signer correctness.
Route navigator, client hint, TLS, storage, and cookie symptoms to minimal observation profiles before editing signer code.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Add profile execution-record fixtures that prove selected profiles were actually run.

dimensions.label: Environment rebuild loop
dimensions.market_pressure: Practical reverse skills progress from first divergence, readiness blockers, and smallest causal environment patches rather than broad shims.
quality_gates: Start from observed divergence.
Preserve every patch as an auditable artifact.
Recommend one next operator command from current artifacts before widening analysis.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Add local harness fixtures with multiple candidate patches and one causal first divergence.

dimensions.label: Replay and delivery quality
dimensions.market_pressure: Strong workflows produce reusable Node/Python/proxy handoffs from accepted replay evidence and diagnose divergent or rejected replay records by failure class.
quality_gates: Only mark delivery ready when accepted replay or server acceptance supports it.
Keep unresolved signers parameterized.
Generated replay clients remain templates until revalidated against runtime or server acceptance.
Generated replay clients must keep a sanitized default base URL and explicit template-only boundary.
Do not let generic response-shape divergence mask transport, crypto, or time-window failures.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Add replay client validation records from non-synthetic accepted evidence.

dimensions.label: Evidence and replay governance
dimensions.market_pressure: Agentic reverse workflows need explicit boundaries between planned, observed, inferred, executed, accepted, and replay-verified states.
quality_gates: Never promote planned actions to observed facts.
Never collapse accepted runtime behavior and local replay parity.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Add benchmark cases that fail when planned MCP actions are treated as executed evidence.

dimensions.label: Cross-domain boundary
dimensions.market_pressure: Advanced ecosystems span JS, WASM, packets, Android, native binaries, and debugger MCPs, but each lane needs a concrete artifact boundary and a handoff record.
quality_gates: Hand off only after preserving the boundary artifact.
Validate handoff records before merging cross-domain facts back into JS evidence.
Do not merge packet, mobile, WASM, or binary facts into verified JS claims without replay evidence.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Keep cross-domain handoff records covered by strict public release checks.

dimensions.label: Release data safety
dimensions.market_pressure: Public reverse-engineering packages are leak-prone because captures, HARs, PCAPs, cookies, tokens, local paths, and case names can be committed accidentally.
quality_gates: Block tracked high and medium release-risk findings.
Keep raw captures and generated artifacts untracked.
dimensions.next_action_if_behind: Add release manifest hashes and export-diff explanations.
